verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only Python usage. The getting-started docs have users set up a Python project with Chroma, and the docs reference client methods (.get/.query with where_document), which implies a Python client. There is no evidence of official TypeScript, Go or Java SDKs; the OpenAPI spec is only a developer building block and earns no credit. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an official Python SDK, any evidence of official TypeScript, Go and Java SDKs, independent corroboration of multi-language SDK quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against official SDKs in the major languages (Python, TypeScript, Go, Java)

citations.quote: In this directory create a new Python project with Chroma set up.
.get and .query can handle where_document search combined with metadata filtering
